subject: COBOL character repertoire
notes: kb/Work PB1965 (w1047a): the fold's reach is now every word key. The Editions word tables (CobolWordsMap, CompilerDirectiveCatalog, ContextSensitiveWords, ImplementorNames, NonstandardExtension, ReservedWords) are keyed by CobolNames.Comparer (WiseOwl.Cobol.Editions references the runtime for it); a word's upper-case KEY (a >>COBOL-WORDS Resolve argument, a C# identifier derived from a class, method, property, program or formal name, a default externalized name, the run-time EXTERNAL identities) is CobolNames.UpperFold, the Annex C fold with only the basic letters raised, never the host's ToUpperInvariant (CobolNameFoldDriftTests.NoHostUpperCase_AsTheKeyOfACobolWord). Before it: FUNCTION <Kelvin>UP under EQUATE "UPPER-CASE" WITH "KUP" was COBOL1501; at 2023 the EXTERNAL items X<final sigma> and X<sigma> were one item (MAIN S), and methods of those names one C# member (CS0111). retired-witness: unit:CobolNameFoldDriftTests.NoOrdinalIgnoreCase_OverACobolWord_InTheCompilerOrTheFrontend (renamed by kb/Work PB2845 when the drift test's scan widened from the compiler and the front end to every project; the same check under its new name is added)
